responsibility: Is the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for the main Arm target option table in arm.opt. It records per-option UrlSuffix associations from option spellings like -march, -mcpu, -mthumb, -mfpu, and other Arm-specific switches to their anchors in the GCC manual, with explicit omissions noted for options that have no matching manual anchor. Its responsibility is not to define options themselves, but to provide the generated option-to-documentation cross-reference data consumed alongside GCC’s option tables.
